messages.author: 49a87a8d4d680c65
messages.subject: rhsave / rhwrite within mapper
parts:
I am creating a lm() R data object in the mapper and trying to save the object into HDFS in the mapper. I have tried both rhsave and rhwrite functions but i am getting this error:

There were R errors, showing 30:
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "rhsave"
Autokill is true and terminating job_201302221706_0012

however i am able to use rhcollect in the mapper and i have loaded Rhipe in the script.

try( { addpkg("Rhipe", "0.69") }, silent=TRUE)
try( { library(Rhipe) }, silent=TRUE)


what is the correct way to do this? does rhsave use mapreduce it self so then i cannot use it in my mapper? thanks.

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhsave / rhwrite within mapper
parts:
Inside a RHIPE job, rhsave will not work.

Why not use rhcollect? do this
a <- lm(...)
rhcollect(somekey, serialize(a, NULL) )

You need to serialize lm objects because these contains R classes that RHIPE's native serializer does not know how to handle.


When you read the data back in say through rhread

y=rhread(outputfolder)
key = y[[1]] [[1]]
lm.object = unserialize(y[[1]][[2]])

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] rhsave / rhwrite within mapper
parts:
you are mixing binary and text objects and writing them to text files.
recipe for pain.

Please use sequence file ouputformat for any analytical tasks and text only if you need to share with non RHIPE workflows.
